subject: Error in loading user-specified environmental data

messages.author: 8438c0751af0771e
messages.subject: Error in loading user-specified environmental data
parts:
Hello,

I am new to Wallace and finding it very easy to use so far. Thank you to the creators! 

I am unfortunately running into an error when I try to load my own environmental data. I have four rasters (.tif) all with identical extent, resolution, crs. When I try to upload just one of them or all of them in a raster stack, I get the error:

```> ! ERROR : Select more than two variables.```. 

I am not given an option to select variables in the user-specified module. When I try to load the files as four individual files (not stacked in one .tif), Wallace hangs and the screen turns gray. I am getting this message in the console:

 ```Warning: Error in names<-: incorrect number of layer names```.

I am unsure how to trouble shoot and would appreciate any advice. Thank you so much in advance.

Elke Windschitl

messages.author: 881c0dd9c7b0d196
messages.subject: Re: Error in loading user-specified environmental data
parts:
Hi Elke, apologies for the late response.
First of all, the variables should be loaded in as separate variables (1 raster per variable) and not as a stack (that explains the error message about loading in more than 2 variables).
The error with the layer names means some of your rasters may have more than one layer- is this the case? I am not sure what data you are using, but maybe your rasters have multiple bands?
My advice is to try using the WorldClim module or download a few worldclim variables and try the user upload option, just to test and make sure it is working on your machine first. This will let us know if it is Wallace or just an issue with your rasters.

If your work is not confidential, you can email the Wallace account (<wallac...@gmail.com>)with your rasters and let me know what species you are modeling and I can test it out myself to see if I can determine the issue.

-Bethany

messages.author: 881c0dd9c7b0d196
messages.subject: Re: Messaggio privato su: Error in loading user-specified environmental data
parts:
You need more than one variable to build a model. So if you wanted to use your landcover file with, say, climate data, you'll need them to be in the same folder so you can select them all.
If you wanted to use the file with Worldclim data, you'll have to download the bioclimatic variables externally (from the WorldClim site) and use the User Data module to upload all the files. It is currently not possible to select one single file, upload it, and then select another. You'll have to drag and select them all at once (at least three are needed to build a model).
